main_text.p: tij condemnationem firmare, & testatam reddere, scribens Ignatium senio, morboq; confectum se munere abdicasse, commorari in Infula ab omnibus honore, & officijs cultum. His motus Nicolaus Zachariam, & Rodoaldum Episcopos ablegat, & coacta Synodo convocatur Ignatius de oblatis sibi criminibus responsurus. Processit sacro Patriarcha ornatu indutus, quo inter eundum spoliatus, Synodo sistitur, condemnatur, & deponitur: quæ postmodum cum sciuisset Nicolaus Pontifex legatos Zachariam,& Rodoaldum exauctoratos anathemate per-cussit, Photium tyrannum, & adulterum pronunciauit, & Synodi suæ decreto deponit, omnesque ab eodem Photio confecra-tos, ipsumque Imperatorem cum omni eius Senatu per literas suas a cœtu fidelium ex-cludit: Legatur vita Ignatij a Niceta scripta. Et si fides huius sapientissimi viri respuitur, adeatur Synodicum, cuius Auctor hæc eadem narrat. page.notes: Greek passage is badly printed and small; accents and several letters are doubtful and marked [?]. Text of the Greek paragraph is best checked against the original. Page number printed as Roman numeral II (scan reads "II" at top centre). No running head, no marginal notes, no text in the margins. The catchword "μα-" is printed at the lower right below the last line, which is the start of the next page. The Latin line "per-cussit" and "ex-cludit" are kept with their printed line-end hyphens. The first paragraph gets cont="true" because the page opens mid-sentence.
